# Frontend Hook Port Adapter Instructions

## Purpose
Translate HTTP client calls to `I<Entity>HookPort` contract. Centralize error mapping & response normalization.

## Artifacts
- `api.<entity>.hook-port.adapter.ts`
- Optional test: `api.<entity>.hook-port.adapter.spec.ts`

## Naming
- Class: `Api<Entity>HookPortAdapter`
- File: `api.<entity>.hook-port.adapter.ts`

## Implementation Rules
| Concern | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Errors | Never throw; return failed `IBaseResponse` |
| Logging | Console/log only unexpected errors |
| HTTP | Use provided `api` client; do not construct fetch manually |

```ts
// Use TID or TUUID as needed
export class Api<Entity>HookPortAdapter implements I<Entity>HookPort {
  constructor(private readonly api: TApi) {}


  public async getAll(): Promise<IBaseResponse<TResponse<Action>>> {
    return this.api.tps.map
      .get()
      .then((response) => {
        if (!response.data) {
          return {
            success: false,
            message: `error.unknown-server-error.${response.status}`,
            status: response.status,
          };
        }

        return response.data;
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: 'error.internal-server-error',
          status: HTTP_STATUS_CODE.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR_500,
        };
      });
}
```

## Tests
- Success: maps `response.data`
- Failure: returns internal server error shape

## Quality Gates
- No `any`
- Consistent error messages
